registry_description: Comprehensive registry of public, institutional, and in-repo textile datasets for thread density metrology, yarn segmentation, and defect recognition.

categories.A: Direct physical density supervision (Warp ends/cm, Weft picks/cm, calibrated FOV)
categories.B: Yarn-level annotations (Warp/weft segmentation, float points, centerlines)
categories.C: Fabric structure and weave datasets (Known weave geometry, known DPI/scale)
categories.D: Defect and industrial inspection datasets (Line-scan web inspection, anomaly masks)
categories.E: Microscopy and fiber-level datasets (High optical magnification, fine parallel structures)
categories.F: Synthetic datasets and procedural generators (Exact mathematical ground truth)

datasets.name: FabricNET: Woven Fabric Texture Recognition and Mass Prediction
datasets.acquisition_hardware: USB Digital Microscope with circular white-LED ring
datasets.imaging_conditions: Surface reflection, fixed working distance ~1.5 cm
datasets.recommended_usage: Primary laboratory microscopy benchmark for dual-engine frequency analysis and feature regression.
datasets.known_limitations: Handheld microscope magnification claimed but not verified with stage micrometer; does not directly transfer to smartphone cameras.

datasets.name: Client Fabric Specimen 2 Benchmark Record
datasets.source_organization: Client Textile Laboratory / Warp & Weft Project
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Reference Smartphone Camera under fixed laboratory stand
datasets.imaging_conditions: Orthogonal top lighting, fixed 10 cm working distance
datasets.annotation_granularity: 5-region discrete manual pick-glass count per ASTM D3775
datasets.recommended_usage: Authoritative commercial acceptance testbed for factory tolerance validation.
datasets.known_limitations: Only one physical specimen swatch currently available in repository; cannot train end-to-end deep learning models alone.

datasets.name: Textile Microtexture Dataset: 100+ Annotated Images & 40+ Quantitative Classification Features
datasets.modality: High-Resolution Optical Rig with 100x Microscope Lens
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Raspberry Pi High Quality Camera + 100x Optical Microscope Lens
datasets.imaging_conditions: Controlled macro lighting, greyscale and color microtexture
datasets.annotation_granularity: Image-level tabular texture features and material labels
datasets.recommended_usage: Feature extraction benchmarking (Haralick, LBP, wavelets) on physical 100x optical microscopy.
datasets.known_limitations: Does not provide explicit physical ends/cm labels; requires unsupervised pitch extraction.

datasets.name: CDATP Fabric Database (Open PBR Textile Surface Database)
datasets.source_organization: Technische Universitat Dresden / Jiangnan University / Zenodo
datasets.modality: Calibrated Optical Surface Scanning (Vizoo xTex System)
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Vizoo xTex calibrated textile scanning system
datasets.imaging_conditions: Controlled photometric stereo, front and back fabric surfaces
ground_truth_attributes: PBR Maps: Base Color, Normal, Displacement, Roughness, Alpha
datasets.annotation_granularity: Pixel-aligned physical surface scans with known metric DPI
datasets.download_method: Zenodo record download via REST API
datasets.recommended_usage: Gold-standard testbed for known DPI surface scale validation (605 DPI) on complex woven structures.
datasets.known_limitations: Full archive is massive (>20 GB); selective download of 10-15 representative woven materials required to adhere to storage budget.

datasets.name: RAW-FABRID: RAW FABRic Image Dataset for Industrial Defect Detection
datasets.source_organization: Mendeley Data / Universitat Politecnica de Valencia
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Basler industrial line-scan camera with dual LED illumination
datasets.imaging_conditions: High-speed moving web on industrial inspection frame
ground_truth_attributes: Pixel binary masks for textile defects
datasets.annotation_granularity: Pixel-level defect masks and clean patch sub-datasets
datasets.download_method: Direct HTTP from Mendeley Data API
datasets.recommended_usage: Unsupervised pretraining of feature representations on high-resolution industrial line-scan fabrics.
datasets.known_limitations: Defect-focused; does not contain physical yarn density counts.

datasets.name: FabriD: Fabric Defect Detection Dataset
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Digital Cameras under varied factory lighting
datasets.annotation_granularity: Polygon masks and bounding boxes via Roboflow
datasets.download_method: Direct HTTP from Mendeley Data API
datasets.recommended_usage: Missing yarn detection and structural anomaly rejection.
datasets.known_limitations: Uncalibrated camera distances; qualitative defect classes.

datasets.name: Roboflow: Warp-Weft-New-Prod
ground_truth_attributes: BBoxes and Polygons for 'warp' and 'weft' strands
datasets.annotation_granularity: Longitudinal bounding boxes covering full visible thread strands
datasets.recommended_usage: Evaluating object detection and NMS suppression on dense parallel yarns.
datasets.known_limitations: Severe NMS suppression (30-50% undercount); lacks metric spatial scale.

datasets.name: Roboflow: Fabric-Lby7e Semantic Segmentation
datasets.modality: Optical Grayscale Surface Imaging with Physical Ruler
datasets.acquisition_hardware: Macro camera with in-frame metric ruler
datasets.annotation_granularity: Fine polygon masks on exposed yarn float crowns
datasets.recommended_usage: Reference for in-frame ruler detection ('measure') and float-point segmentation.
datasets.known_limitations: Low reported mIoU (35.7%) in base training; float points fragmented.

datasets.name: Procedural Physics-Simulated Synthetic Fabric Generator
datasets.imaging_conditions: Procedural fiber fuzz (Perlin noise), illumination gradients, variable skew (-20 to +20 deg)
datasets.annotation_granularity: Pixel-exact ground truth masks and centerlines with zero human annotation error
datasets.recommended_usage: Pretraining segmentation models and verifying geometric pitch extraction pipelines.
datasets.known_limitations: Synthetic domain gap; real smartphone swatches have complex 3D yarn twists and uneven slubs.
